name: Vercel
mood: Disciplined monochrome developer terminal on near-white paper with Geist Sans display type, Geist Mono metadata, 6px precision corners, hairline rings, and triangle-mark product language.

carbon.role: SVG icon fills, triangle logo mark, and pure graphic silhouettes only.

obsidian.role: Primary headings, filled buttons, dark card fills, nav borders, and list markers.

charcoal.role: Body paragraphs, card descriptions, and secondary button labels.

stone.role: Muted captions, helper text, and de-emphasized UI labels.

slate.role: Customer brand names and quiet heading variants.

smoke.role: Tertiary text, placeholder copy, and subtle icon fills.

ash.role: Disabled text, muted labels, and logo watermarks.

hairline.role: 1px borders on buttons, links, cards, and input edges.

paperWhite.role: Page canvas, card surroundings, and light button fills.

pureWhite.role: Elevated cards, inset highlights, and input fields.

terminalGreen.role: Confirmation text, command success marks, links, tags, and tiny emphasized phrases.

fallbacks.mono: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

rules: Use Geist Sans for display, body, navigation, cards, buttons, and product copy.
Use Geist Mono for labels, metadata, code blocks, CLI output, uppercase eyebrows, and tiny stamps.
Use tight tracking at 30px, 56px, and 64px heading sizes.
Do not use heavy heading weights.

components.name: Filled Black Button
components.recipe: Obsidian fill, Pure White text, 6px radius, 12px to 20px horizontal padding, Geist Sans 14px/400.

components.name: Ghost Outline Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Charcoal text, Hairline ring, 6px radius, 20px padding, Geist Sans 14px/400.

components.name: Pill Button
components.recipe: Obsidian or Pure White fill with contrasting text, 9999px radius, compact 12px horizontal padding, nav/header only.

components.name: Text Link Button
components.recipe: No background, no border, 0px radius, Obsidian or Charcoal text, Geist Sans 14px to 16px.

components.name: Bordered Card
components.recipe: Pure White, 6px radius, 16px padding, border via stacked rings: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 0 0 2px #fafafa.

components.name: Inverted Card
components.recipe: Obsidian fill, Pure White text, 6px radius, used sparingly.

components.name: CLI Output Panel
components.recipe: Pure White panel with Geist Mono 12px to 13px, triangle command prefixes, and Terminal Green checkmark confirmations.

components.name: Logo Strip Row
components.recipe: Horizontal grayscale customer logo strip with 24px to 32px gaps, softened to Slate or Ash.

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.recipe: Geist Mono 11px/400, uppercase, 0.071em tracking, Obsidian, 12px gap before heading.

components.name: Top Nav Bar
components.recipe: 64px sticky Paper White nav, optional backdrop blur, wordmark left, nav links center-left, action cluster right, no border.

components.name: Hero Composition
components.recipe: Asymmetric three-zone hero: headline left, black triangle mark center/offset, eyebrow stack right, no image background.

components.name: Feature Card Grid
components.recipe: Two-up or three-up grid with bordered cards, 16px to 24px padding, 30px headings, Charcoal descriptions, and embedded product proof.

do: Use Obsidian for primary text and filled buttons.
Use Carbon only for the triangle mark and SVG fills.
Apply 6px radius to cards, buttons, and bordered containers.
Use 9999px radius only for tight nav pills.
Set headings at weight 400 to 450 with tight tracking.
Use Geist Mono uppercase labels at 11px to 12px with 0.071em tracking.
Build depth with stacked hairline rings.
Use triangle command prefixes and Terminal Green checkmark confirmations in CLI panels.
Keep sections separated by 96px to 128px whitespace.
dont: Do not introduce chromatic UI color outside Terminal Green and optional decorative gradients.
Do not use pure black for text.
Do not use pure white for dark surfaces.
Do not use border radius larger than 6px on cards or rectangular buttons.
Do not set body or heading type outside the Obsidian, Charcoal, and Stone scale.
Do not use 300, 600, or 700 weights for headings.
Do not use Geist Sans for labels, metadata, or code.
